sa: ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु । सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
iast: oṃ saha nāv avatu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai |
tejasvi nāv adhītam astu | mā vidviṣāvahai ||

tr.text: Om ! May He protect us both together (by illumining the nature of knowledge). May He sustain us both (by ensuring the fruits of knowledge). May we attain the vigour (of knowledge) together. Let what we learn enlighten us. Let us not hate each other. Om ! Peace ! Peace ! Peace !
